item.title: OmniRoute 231-Provider Gateway Review 2026: Free AI Gateway for Coding Agents
item.description:
OmniRoute is worth testing if you run coding agents across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, or Copilot and want one OpenAI-compatible endpoint that drains free tiers first. The catch: the old 231-provider claim is stale. Current primary docs list 237 providers, 90+ free tiers, and real operational caveats.

What changed since the OmniRoute 231-provider gateway snapshot?

The keyword people are searching for is still “omniroute 231-provider gateway”, but the project has already moved past that number. As of July 10, 2026, the OmniRoute README describes the project as a free AI gateway with 237 providers, 90+ free tiers, 17 routing strategies, and one local endpoint at http://localhost:20128/v1. The public website still shows nearby but slightly different numbers in places, and npm metadata still has older “160+ providers” language.
